high_level_description: The image is a split-screen featuring two photographs of the same person at what appears to be a red carpet event for the movie "Spider-Man: No Way Home." In the left photograph, the individual is shown from the shoulders up, wearing a deep red, form-fitting dress with thin straps. The dress has a cut-out design on the chest area. She is also wearing black sheer gloves that extend from her elbows down to her wrists. Her hair is styled straight and falls over her shoulders. She has a light makeup look with defined eyebrows, long eyelashes, and a glossy lip color.
